content.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Executive Assistant in GitLab’s Chief Technology Officer (CTO) organization, you support senior engineering leaders, and report to a Staff Executive Business Administrator in the CTO organization. These leaders are responsible for advancing product capabilities, reliability and operational excellence, GitLab’s next-generation architecture, scaling the business, and accelerating R&D hiring. You keep their priorities aligned through scheduling, meeting preparation, clear communication, and follow-through. In your first year, you build trusted relationships across their teams and with partner EBAs. You establish reliable processes for meeting preparation and follow-through, travel, expenses, recruiting coordination, team events and offsites, and the cross-functional requests that come with customer escalations. This role is based in the United States or Canada and requires Pacific time hours (about 8 AM to 5 PM PT) and some flexibility to support meetings across global time zones. Travel is expected a few times a year (about two to three trips) for offsites and events.

What You’ll Do

Manage complex calendars for your assigned leaders across time zones. Vet requests, resolve conflicts, recommend tradeoffs, and protect time for focused work and breaks in line with GitLab’s meeting practices.

Maintain regular communication with each leader and track updates from direct reports, peers, and cross-functional partners. Flag dependencies, upcoming deliverables, and items that need review, decisions, or escalation before they slip.

Plan and execute all-hands, ask-me-anything sessions, organizational summits, leadership offsites, and team-level engineering events, including hands-on support for our annual R&D summit (1,000+ attendees). Coordinate logistics, agendas, speakers, content, and post-event follow-up with partner executive business administrators across Engineering, Product, Sales, and Customer Success.

Support hiring for senior technical roles by coordinating interview loops, debriefs, executive closing calls, and candidate communication across time zones. Partner with Recruiting, People Operations, Information Technology, and Security on onboarding and team logistics.

Coordinate domestic and international travel, including transportation, lodging, visas, security needs, and supporting documentation. Anticipate disruptions, arrange alternatives, and process accurate expense reports and reimbursements on time.

Improve administrative processes, documentation, and leadership trackers so priorities and next steps stay clear. Provide coverage and share practices across the executive business administrator community.

What You’ll Bring

Experience supporting VP-level or senior leaders, ideally in a fast-paced software, SaaS or AI environment (engineering or CTO exposure is a plus), with an understanding of their planning cycles and reviews.

Experience managing complex calendars, travel, expenses, and shifting priorities for multiple senior leaders, with sound judgment about competing requests.

Experience running all-hands and offsites end to end for teams of 200 or more in a remote or hybrid setting, including managing dependencies and responding to disruptions.

A project management approach: define owners, due dates, and next steps; anticipate risks; and keep multiple workstreams moving independently. Comfort tracking action items in GitLab issues and epics or similar tools such as Jira.

Clear written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to turn information from multiple sources into useful agendas, summaries, and preparation materials. An asynchronous-first approach, with documentation as part of your day-to-day work.

Discretion with sensitive information, including organizational changes, performance matters, and incidents, and the ability to build trusted relationships across functions and backgrounds.

Comfort using Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Okta, Navan, Claude, or similar administrative and expense platforms, and flexibility to support meetings across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific, including outside standard hours when needed.

Proactive, responsive, ownership-minded executive support with a white-glove approach, a great attitude, and the ability to act without being asked.

A strong team player who communicates openly with the executive support team and covers for peers when needed.

Practical experience using AI tools (Claude is our standard) to improve administrative work, with the judgment to check outputs for accuracy.

About the team

You’ll join GitLab’s CTO organization, supporting multiple senior engineering leaders (typically two to three members of the engineering leadership team). Together, their priorities span advancing product capabilities, reliability, next-generation architecture, growth of the GitLab business, and engineering hiring. You’ll work with their teams and a globally distributed network of executive business administrators, using asynchronous communication, clear documentation, and shared processes to coordinate work and keep commitments visible as plans change.

How GitLab will support you

Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

Flexible Paid Time Off

Team Member Resource Groups

Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Growth and Development Fund

Parental leave

Home office support

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range

$78,400—$133,200 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

Flexible Paid Time Off

Team Member Resource Groups

Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Growth and Development Fund

Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.
